subject.title: TUI: Add config support for --deliver flag default

question: Should OpenClaw add a persistent TUI delivery default, and should the canonical surface be `tui.deliver`, an in-TUI setting, or a changed CLI default with explicit opt-out?
rationale: The missing capability is source-verifiable, but OpenClaw policy sets a high bar for new config/default surfaces and current main documents delivery as an explicit launch-time choice.

options.title: Approve a persistent TUI default
options.body: Add the default through the chosen canonical surface with schema/help/docs/tests and explicit CLI flag precedence.

options.title: Keep delivery launch-only
options.body: Leave delivery as an intentional per-session flag and document or close the ergonomics request after maintainer confirmation.

options.title: Change the CLI default
options.body: Make delivery on by default with an opt-out only if maintainers accept the compatibility and message-delivery behavior change.

recommendation.title: Approve a persistent TUI default
recommendation.body: Add the default through the chosen canonical surface with schema/help/docs/tests and explicit CLI flag precedence.

likelyOwner.reason: The current TUI CLI/runtime history and the remaining product/default contract point most strongly to this owner signal.
